finish_gates.proof: Only project/canonical and code/canonical remain as current remote branches and no known live consumer depends on historical branch names.

A genuinely fresh agent/session with repository-only bootstrap can recover objective, authority, fresh project/code heads, router/blocker, next action and working method without chat context or a parallel methodology.
Required canonical regression/challenge suite passes on exact current code/canonical SHA.
Authenticated intended host proves two consecutive automatic wakes without Owner relaunch and one real Codex result is consumed by the following decision.
After terminal bounded task state, system selects next legitimate unmet mission or durable NOOP/PARK without human task substitution.
Bounded non-economic/synthetic-safe canonical witness preserves identity through research/control/result/memory and restart/duplicate/stale-head recovery.
No P0 engineering/autonomy blocker remains and normal future work can proceed as scientific/economic system use without another architecture campaign.

behavioral_opportunity_rescue.target: Every bounded material candidate disposition to PARK, BLOCK or STOP

FRESH_CONTEXT: Bootstrap exclusively from fresh project/canonical and code/canonical SHA, north star, current router and canonical method; retrieve only decision-changing primary evidence; do not reconstruct prior chats or treat a branch name as authority.
Independently formulate economic payer, contractual right or forced flow, PIT clocks, executable instruments and realistic cost/risk before comparing historical candidates.
Reuse frozen negative outcomes as scoped evidence, then preserve one decisive action and exact unknowns without inventing past work.
LONG_CONTEXT: Reconcile current project/code heads and router despite a long conversation; historical chat, earlier assistant conclusions and prior prompts are locators, never authority.

Before adopting prior rankings, separately challenge mechanism, frozen expression, tested route, capital and broker access; seek one decision-changing counterexample and primary proof, not unlimited historical reconstruction.
Carry forward proved finished work, negative results, multiplicity and economic unknowns without reopening closed trials, laundering post-outcome variants, or confusing context length with proof.
